title.rendered: Grizzly Peak Century bike ride May 7th

content.rendered:
Randy Jenkins, KA6BQF is looking for help with the Grizzly Peak Century Ride on May 7th. The event is a 60 and 100 mile bicycle ride involving around 700 cyclists, on paved roads, through the East Bay hills. Start / Finish is in Moraga. Course runs north as far as Port Costa and south as far as Castro Valley. Amateur radio operators provide communications between six fixed location rest stops. Some hams also volunteer as sag drivers or sag communicators. Randy needs 9 to 12 operators for fixed locations, 5 to 11 sag drivers or communicators.

For further information please use the following link to the Grizzly Peak Century Ride Webpage or contact Randy at ka6bqf@arrl.net.
